claims.statement: SolarEdge's official developer platform exposes production, consumption, storage, alerts, historical telemetry, and inverter-level diagnostics with permissioned fleet access.
SolarEdge's own monitoring product already offers module-level alerts and remote diagnostics, while Fronius exposes system and device historical and aggregated data through its official API.

contrary_evidence: OEM monitoring platforms already diagnose their own fleets and can restrict or price API access.
No gathered primary evidence yet proves installers will pay for cross-OEM triage.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: a multi-OEM labelled fault-to-fix dataset unavailable inside any single manufacturer's fleet
fingerprint.customer: PV installers, O&M firms, equipment wholesalers, and warranty administrators with mixed residential fleets
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: renewable wholesalers, installer groups, insurer/warranty programmes, and the founder's family company
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: vendor-neutral telemetry normalisation, anomaly prioritisation, guided tests, and evidence-pack generation
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: the service network pays per connected asset and completed evidence bundle
fingerprint.problem_trigger: telemetry shows underproduction, an alert, communications loss, or a repeat customer complaint

founder_fit: Best direct leverage of the family renewable company, data-science background, and automation preference; a real fleet pilot is possible without capital equipment or public branding.
risks: Bad recommendations can waste truck rolls or delay safety-critical intervention.
API deprecation and permission loss can break coverage.
Warranty acceptance criteria differ by OEM and must not be overstated.

structure.control_point: the remote triage decision that determines truck roll, parts preparation, and warranty-evidence completeness
structure.critical_dependency: permissioned multi-OEM telemetry and a labelled outcome set linking alerts to confirmed repairs and warranty decisions

thesis: A permissioned utility for residential and small-commercial PV service fleets can normalise multi-vendor telemetry, rank likely fault causes, request the right field tests, and assemble a reproducible pre-visit or warranty evidence bundle. Wholesalers, O&M networks, and insurers distribute it one-to-many; daily anomalies and each service case are paid operational triggers.
title: Vendor-Neutral Solar Fault Triage and Warranty Evidence Utility
uncertainties: Access to module-level data across enough OEMs.
Actual avoidable truck-roll cost and willingness to share it.
